name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: Owning the first phase of the customer journey is the work I'm best at. At Wix I onboarded 25+ clients a month at 110% of my implementation target, many of them established retail businesses launching an online store, and I trained onboarding teams of up to 30 on how to do it consistently. At Birdeye I tracked partner usage to catch low adoption early and retained all but one of 15 to 20 partners.

Your posting puts AI right next to judgment, which is how I use it. I use Claude and ChatGPT daily to research customers, draft documentation, and personalize communication, and I built rubric-based grading to check AI output in my own client workflows before anything goes out. The goal is more time for the conversations that actually move adoption.

I haven't worked with consumer panel data or designed research surveys, and that's where I'd ramp first. I learn data-heavy platforms quickly and I'm comfortable with a trip or two each quarter. Open to a conversation at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
